title: Test Case Specification
description: Canonical test specification produced by the Test Design Agent. Defines every test that should exist for the application — the complete WHAT, not the HOW. This contract is the single source of truth between the Test Design Agent and the Code Generation Agent. It is technology-agnostic, business-oriented, and contains no Playwright, Selenium, Cypress, or any framework-specific code.

runId.description: Globally unique identifier for the test execution run. Must match the runId across all pipeline contracts.

requestId.description: Correlation identifier from the originating HTTP request. Must match the requestId across all pipeline contracts.

testSuites.description: Logical test suites organising test cases by business domain, module, feature, or risk level. Each suite aggregates related test cases and provides context about what area of the application is being tested.

coverageSummary.description: Aggregated coverage metrics across all test suites and test cases. Provides at-a-glance indicators for feature coverage, workflow coverage, entity coverage, page coverage, business capability coverage, and risk coverage.

generationMetadata.description: Metadata about the test design generation process — when it ran, which source contracts were consumed, the agent version, overall confidence, and warnings.

uuid.description: A universally unique identifier in standard 8-4-4-4-12 hexadecimal format.

suiteId.description: Globally unique identifier for this test suite within the specification.

name.description: Human-readable name of the test suite (e.g. Authentication, User Management, Orders, Inventory, Reports, Billing, Dashboard, Administration, Settings).

description.description: Description of what area of the application this test suite covers and the testing objectives.

moduleId.description: The moduleId from application-inventory.json that this test suite primarily covers.

featureIds.description: Feature IDs from application-inventory.json that are covered by this test suite.

entityIds.description: Entity IDs from application-inventory.json that are covered by this test suite.

priority.description: Overall priority of this test suite within the test specification.

risk.description: Overall assessed risk level for this test suite.

estimatedDuration.description: Estimated total execution time for all test cases in this suite, in seconds.

testTypes.description: The types of testing covered by this suite.

testCases.description: The individual test cases belonging to this suite.

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for categorising the test suite. Examples: 'smoke', 'regression', 'critical-path', 'release-blocker'.

testSuite.description: A logical test suite grouping related test cases by business domain, module, or feature.

testCaseId.description: Globally unique identifier for this test case within the specification.

name.description: Descriptive name of the test case that clearly communicates what is being tested (e.g. 'Create a new user with valid email and password', 'Login with expired credentials shows error message').

description.description: Detailed description of the test case, including the scenario being tested and the expected behaviour.

businessObjective.description: The business reason this test exists — what risk it mitigates or what requirement it validates.

testType.description: The primary type of testing this test case performs.

subTypes.description: Additional test type classifications for this test case.

priority.description: The priority of this test case within the test suite.

severity.description: The severity of a failure in this test case — how impactful a bug would be.

riskLevel.description: The assessed risk level for this specific test case.

automation.description: Automation feasibility assessment for this test case.

traceability.description: Rich traceability links connecting this test case back to the application model.

preconditions.description: All conditions that must be satisfied before this test case can execute.

testData.description: Data specifications for this test case — inputs, fixtures, generated data, boundary values, and edge cases.

steps.description: Ordered sequence of abstract business actions that constitute this test case. Each step describes WHAT to do, not HOW to do it.

assertions.description: Expected assertions that must hold true for this test case to pass.

expectedOutcomes.description: The expected end states of the system after this test case executes.

negativeTests.description: Negative testing specifications describing invalid inputs, error conditions, and failure scenarios.

edgeCases.description: Edge case specifications for boundary conditions, extreme values, and unusual system states.

cleanup.description: Cleanup actions required after test execution to restore the system to a known state.

executionStrategy.description: Execution strategy for this test case — parallelism, retry policy, dependencies, and estimated runtime.

tags.description: Arbitrary tags for categorising the test case. Examples: 'smoke', 'regression', 'positive', 'negative', 'boundary', 'auth-required', 'data-intensive'.

review.description: Review and approval record for this test case.

testCase.description: A single test case representing a complete test specification. Contains everything needed to understand WHAT should be tested — preconditions, test data, abstract steps, assertions, expected outcomes, negative testing, edge cases, and cleanup.

testType.description: Classification of the type of testing a test case performs.

priorityLevel.description: Priority level indicating the importance of the test case or suite.

severityLevel.description: Severity level indicating the impact of a failure in this test case.

riskLevel.description: Risk level indicating the assessed likelihood and impact of defects in the tested area.

feasibility.description: The feasibility of automating this test case. FullyAutomated means every step can be automated. PartiallyAutomated means some steps require manual intervention. ManualOnly means the test requires human judgment.

aiConfidence.description: The AI's confidence in the automation assessment. Ranges from 0.0 (no confidence) to 1.0 (full confidence).

humanReviewRequired.description: Whether a human must review the generated code for this test case before execution.

suggestedFramework.description: The suggested automation framework for this test case. The Code Generation Agent may override based on project configuration.

estimatedLinesOfCode.description: Estimated lines of code required to implement this test case.

automationAssessment.description: Assessment of how automatable this test case is, including AI confidence and suggested framework.

moduleId.description: The moduleId from application-inventory.json that this test case validates.

featureIds.description: Feature IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case validates.

workflowIds.description: Workflow IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case exercises.

entityIds.description: Entity IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case manipulates or validates.

pageIds.description: Page IDs from dom-inventory.json / application-inventory.json that this test case navigates through.

formIds.description: Form IDs from dom-inventory.json that this test case interacts with.

tableIds.description: Table IDs from dom-inventory.json that this test case validates.

dialogIds.description: Dialog IDs from dom-inventory.json that this test case interacts with.

riskIndicatorIds.description: Risk indicator IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case addresses.

businessCapabilityIds.description: Business capability IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case supports.

validationRuleIds.description: Validation rule IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case exercises.

integrationPointIds.description: Integration point IDs from application-inventory.json that this test case touches.

requirementIds.description: External requirement or user story identifiers that this test case maps to.

traceability.description: Rich traceability links connecting this test case back to the full application model. Every test case should reference at minimum the module, feature, and entity it validates.

required.description: Whether authentication is required before this test can execute.

userRole.description: The role the authenticated user must have (e.g. Admin, Manager, Editor, Viewer).

userState.description: The required state of the authenticated user account.

loginMethod.description: The login method required (e.g. form, oauth, sso, magicLink).

authentication.description: Authentication requirements that must be satisfied before test execution.

requiredPermissions.description: Permission identifiers required to execute this test.

requiredRoles.description: Role names required to execute this test.

authorization.description: Authorization requirements that must be satisfied before test execution.

entityName.description: The name of the entity type (e.g. User, Order, Customer).

count.description: The minimum number of existing records required.

state.description: The required state of the existing records (e.g. 'active', 'pending', 'completed').

description.description: Description of the records required and why.

items.description: Specification for existing records that must be present before the test.

existingRecords.description: Existing records that must be present in the system before test execution.

featureFlags.description: Feature flags that must be enabled or disabled for this test. Keys are feature flag names, values are the required state.

data.description: Data conditions that must be satisfied before test execution.

requiredBrowsers.description: Browsers this test must run on.

viewport.description: Required viewport dimensions for this test.

environment.description: Environment conditions required for this test case.

testCaseId.description: The testCaseId of a test that must pass before this test can run.

type.description: Hard means the dependency must pass. Soft means it should ideally pass but is not blocking. Data means the dependency creates data this test requires.

items.description: A dependency on another test case.

dependencies.description: Other test cases that must execute (and pass) before this test case can run.

sessionTokens.description: Whether valid session tokens must be present.

browserState.description: Required browser state — localStorage, sessionStorage, cookies, and session tokens.

preconditionSet.description: Complete set of preconditions that must be satisfied before a test case can execute.

name.description: The logical name of the input value (e.g. 'email', 'password', 'firstName', 'orderQuantity').

type.description: The data type of the input value.

source.description: How the input value is obtained.

sensitive.description: Whether this input contains sensitive data (PII, credentials, financial). Must be masked or injected securely.

description.description: Description of what this input represents and any special considerations.

items.description: A single input value for the test case.

inputs.description: Input values required for test execution. Each input includes the value, type, source, and sensitivity classification.

name.description: The logical name of the generated data.

constraints.description: Constraints for the generated data (e.g. 'minLength: 8', 'pattern: ^[A-Z]', 'unique: true').

description.description: Description of what this generated data represents.

items.description: Specification for data to be generated at runtime.

generatedData.description: Data that must be generated at runtime rather than specified statically.

name.description: The logical name of the fixture.

fixtureRef.description: Reference to the fixture file or data set.

items.description: A reference to external fixture data.

fixtures.description: References to external fixture files or datasets to load for this test.

parameterName.description: The name of the parameter to vary.

values.description: The values to iterate over for this parameter.

items.description: A parameter whose values are varied across multiple executions.

parameterizedValues.description: Parameterized values for data-driven testing. Each parameter defines values that the test should be executed with.

fieldName.description: The name of the field with boundary constraints.

category.description: The boundary category this value belongs to.

testValues.description: Values to test at and around the boundaries.

items.description: Boundary value specifications for a single field.

boundaryValues.description: Boundary value specifications for fields with numeric, length, or range constraints.

fieldName.description: The name of the field receiving invalid input.

expectedError.description: The expected error message or validation feedback.

items.description: A single invalid input value for negative testing.

invalidValues.description: Invalid input values for negative testing scenarios.

sensitiveData.description: Whether this test case involves sensitive data (PII, credentials, financial information) that must be handled securely.

dataVolume.description: The volume of data involved in this test. Single uses one record. Small uses tens of records. Large uses thousands. VeryLarge uses tens of thousands or more.

testDataSpec.description: Complete test data specification for a test case. Includes literal inputs, generated data, fixture references, parameterized values, boundary values, invalid values, and data volume classification.

stepNumber.description: The sequential step number within the test case.

action.description: The abstract business action to perform. This is NOT an implementation command — it describes WHAT to do at a business level.

description.description: Human-readable description of what this step does and why.

targetPageId.description: The pageId from dom-inventory.json / application-inventory.json where this action occurs.

targetFeatureId.description: The featureId from application-inventory.json that this step exercises.

targetFormId.description: The formId from dom-inventory.json that this step interacts with.

targetDialogId.description: The dialogId from dom-inventory.json that this step interacts with.

inputReference.description: The name of an input or generated data value from the testData section to use in this step.

expectedTransition.description: The expected navigation or state transition after this step (e.g. 'User is redirected to dashboard', 'Modal closes', 'Form resets').

decisionPoint.description: Whether this step represents a branching decision point in the workflow.

validation.description: What should be validated immediately after this step (e.g. 'Error message is displayed', 'Record appears in table', 'User remains on same page').

type.description: The type of wait condition required before proceeding.

condition.description: Description of the condition to wait for.

waitCondition.description: Wait condition that must be satisfied before the next step executes.

notes.description: Additional notes for the Code Generation Agent about implementation considerations for this step.

testStep.description: A single abstract step in a test case. Steps describe WHAT business action to perform, not HOW to perform it. Each step references the target page, feature, form, or dialog by ID from upstream contracts.

businessAction.description: An abstract business action representing WHAT to do. These are technology-agnostic actions that the Code Generation Agent maps to framework-specific implementations.

type.description: The category of assertion to perform.

description.description: Human-readable description of what is being asserted.

expectedValue.description: The expected value for value-based assertions.

actualSource.description: Description of where the actual value comes from (e.g. 'page title', 'form field value', 'table cell text', 'API response field').

targetPageId.description: The pageId where this assertion is evaluated.

targetFormId.description: The formId where this assertion is evaluated.

targetTableId.description: The tableId where this assertion is evaluated.

severity.description: The severity if this assertion fails.

stepNumber.description: The step number after which this assertion is checked.

negated.description: Whether this assertion should be negated — verify that something is NOT true.

assertion.description: An expected assertion that must hold true for the test case to pass. Each assertion references the type of validation, expected value, and target component by ID.

assertionType.description: A technology-agnostic assertion type describing WHAT to validate, not HOW to validate it.

successState.description: Description of the system state indicating the test passed.

failureState.description: Description of the system state indicating the test failed.

businessRuleValidation.description: Description of the business rule that is validated by this test.

workflowCompletion.description: The expected workflow completion state if this test exercises a workflow.

entityName.description: The name of the entity whose state is affected.

beforeState.description: The state of the entity before the test.

afterState.description: The expected state of the entity after the test.

entityState.description: Expected entity state change resulting from this test.

navigationDestination.description: The pageId of the expected page after the test completes.

expectedValue.description: The expected value of the attribute.

dataAssertions.description: Data-level outcome assertions about entity attribute values.

businessImpact.description: Description of the business impact if this outcome is not achieved.

expectedOutcomeSet.description: Complete set of expected outcomes for the test case, describing the success state, failure state, business rule validation, workflow completion, entity state changes, and navigation destination.

category.description: The category of negative test scenario.

description.description: Description of the negative scenario being tested.

fieldName.description: The field receiving the invalid input.

items.description: A single input for the negative scenario.

inputs.description: Input values that trigger the negative scenario.

expectedBehavior.description: The expected system behaviour under this negative condition.

type.description: The expected error type (e.g. validation, authorization, notFound, conflict, serverError).

location.description: Where the error is displayed (e.g. 'field level', 'form level', 'toast', 'modal', 'page').

httpStatus.description: The expected HTTP status code for API-level negative tests.

expectedError.description: Expected error details when this negative scenario is triggered.

severity.description: The severity if this negative scenario reveals a defect.

negativeTestSpec.description: Specification for a negative test scenario — what happens when the system receives invalid inputs or experiences failure conditions.

category.description: The category of edge case being tested.

description.description: Description of the edge case scenario.

fieldName.description: The field involved in the edge case.

items.description: A single input for the edge case scenario.

inputs.description: Input values that create the edge case condition.

expectedBehavior.description: The expected system behaviour under this edge condition.

edgeCaseSpec.description: Specification for an edge case test scenario — how the system behaves at and beyond expected limits.

required.description: Whether cleanup is required after this test case.

actions.description: Business-level cleanup actions to perform (e.g. 'Delete created user', 'Reset feature flag', 'Clear session', 'Restore original data').

entityName.description: The entity type to clean up.

identifier.description: Identifier of the specific record to clean up.

dataCleanup.description: Data records that must be cleaned up after test execution.

authentication.description: Whether authentication state should be cleared.

browserState.description: Whether browser state (localStorage, cookies) should be cleared.

featureFlags.description: Whether feature flags should be restored to original values.

stateRestore.description: System state that must be restored after test execution.

cleanupSpec.description: Cleanup specification describing what must be restored or removed after test execution to leave the system in a known state.

parallelizable.description: Whether this test case can be executed in parallel with other test cases.

sequential.description: Whether this test case must run sequentially and cannot be parallelized.

retries.description: Number of retry attempts allowed on failure.

retryDelay.description: Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds.

retryPolicy.description: Retry policy for flaky or unreliable test cases.

dependencyChain.description: Ordered list of testCaseIds that must execute before this test case. Unlike preconditions.dependencies, these are execution ordering constraints.

flakyProbability.description: Estimated probability of flaky behaviour. 0.0 means extremely stable. 1.0 means very flaky.

estimatedRuntime.description: Estimated execution time for this test case in seconds.

timeout.description: Maximum allowed execution time for this test case in seconds. Overrides the suite-level or run-level timeout.

headless.description: Whether this test case can run in headless mode.

workerRequirements.description: Special worker requirements for executing this test case.

executionStrategy.description: Execution strategy for the test case — parallelism, retry policy, dependency chains, flaky probability, estimated runtime, and worker requirements.

totalSuites.description: Total number of test suites defined.

totalTestCases.description: Total number of test cases defined across all suites.

totalSteps.description: Total number of test steps across all test cases.

totalAssertions.description: Total number of assertions across all test cases.

totalNegativeScenarios.description: Total number of negative test scenarios defined.

totalEdgeCases.description: Total number of edge case scenarios defined.

coveredFeatures.description: Features with at least one test case.

coveragePercentage.description: Percentage of features covered by test cases.

coveredWorkflows.description: Workflows with at least one test case.

coveredEntities.description: Entities with at least one test case.

coveredPages.description: Pages with at least one test case referencing them.

totalCapabilities.description: Total business capabilities in the application.

coveredCapabilities.description: Capabilities with at least one test case.

totalRiskIndicators.description: Total risk indicators in the application.

coveredRiskIndicators.description: Risk indicators with at least one test case.

testTypeBreakdown.description: Count of test cases by test type. Keys are testType values, values are counts. Example: {'smoke': 5, 'regression': 42, 'functional': 28, 'negative': 15}.

priorityBreakdown.description: Count of test cases by priority. Keys are priority values, values are counts.

estimatedTotalRuntime.description: Estimated total execution time for all test cases in seconds.

automationBreakdown.description: Count of test cases by automation feasibility. Keys are feasibility values ('fullyAutomated', 'partiallyAutomated', 'manualOnly'), values are counts.

coverageSummary.description: Aggregated coverage metrics across all test suites and test cases. Provides at-a-glance indicators for what areas of the application are covered by tests and how confident the coverage is.

generatedBy.description: Identifier of the AI agent or system that generated this test case.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this test case was generated.

generationConfidence.description: The AI's confidence in the accuracy and completeness of this test case.

reviewedBy.description: Identifier of the human or system that reviewed this test case.

reviewedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this test case was reviewed.

approvalStatus.description: The current approval status of this test case.

approvedBy.description: Identifier of the human or system that approved this test case.

approvedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this test case was approved.

reviewComments.description: Comments from the reviewer about changes needed or observations about the test case.

revision.description: Revision number of this test case. Increments each time the test case is modified.

reviewRecord.description: Review and approval record for a test case. Tracks generation, review, and approval workflow with timestamps and confidence scores.

generatedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the test specification was generated.

agentVersion.description: Version identifier of the Test Design Agent that produced this output.

applicationInventory.description: Whether application-inventory.json was used as a source.

domInventory.description: Whether dom-inventory.json was used as a source.

crawlPackage.description: Whether crawl-package.json was used as a source.

testRunRequest.description: Whether test-run-request.json was used as a source.

applicationInventoryRef.description: Reference to the source application-inventory.json file or identifier.

domInventoryRef.description: Reference to the source dom-inventory.json file or identifier.

sourceContracts.description: Records which source contracts were consumed to produce this test specification.

totalInputFeatures.description: Total number of features processed from the application inventory.

totalInputWorkflows.description: Total number of workflows processed from the application inventory.

totalInputEntities.description: Total number of entities processed from the application inventory.

totalInputPages.description: Total number of pages processed from the application inventory.

totalGeneratedTests.description: Total number of test cases generated across all suites.

strategiesUsed.description: Strategies used to generate test cases (e.g. 'workflowCoverage', 'crudMatrix', 'validationRules', 'boundaryAnalysis', 'negativeScenarioInference', 'riskBased').

confidence.description: Overall confidence score for the generated test specification.

warnings.description: Non-fatal warnings encountered during test case generation.

errors.description: Fatal or unrecoverable errors encountered during generation.

generationMetadata.description: Metadata about the test case generation process — when it ran, which source contracts were consumed, the agent version, generation strategies used, overall confidence, and warnings.

code.description: Machine-readable event code. Examples: FEATURE_NO_WORKFLOW, WORKFLOW_AMBIGUOUS, ENTITY_NO_CRUD, PAGE_UNREACHABLE, VALIDATION_CONFLICT, COVERAGE_GAP.

moduleId.description: The moduleId associated with this event, if applicable.

featureId.description: The featureId associated with this event, if applicable.

workflowId.description: The workflowId associated with this event, if applicable.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the event occurred.

generationEvent.description: A single warning or error event recorded during test case generation.
